title: opstruss.catalog.yaml
description: The root of an OpsTruss catalog: a directory of plugins and components.

opstruss.description: The oldest OpsTruss version that reads this file, as MAJOR.MINOR.

shared.description: Paths that every package of the catalog may use, relative to its root.

packages.description: The packages of the catalog, which a project uses as <catalog>.<package> or alone as <repository>/<package>@<ref>, by name, wherever its directory is: a directory relative to the root, named by its last directory; a glob such as tools/*, whose * matches within one level and takes the directories with opstruss.plugin.yaml or opstruss.yaml; or a name with a path. Without it, every subdirectory of the root with opstruss.plugin.yaml or opstruss.yaml is a package, named by its directory.

oneOf.description: A directory relative to the root, or a glob of directories in which * matches within one level, as tools/*; each is named by its last directory, and a glob takes only the directories with opstruss.plugin.yaml or opstruss.yaml.
A package with a name of its own.

path.description: The directory of the package, relative to the root, without a glob.
